entries.title: Read from the keyboard the rest of what resting the pointer shows
entries.body: Tab now also reaches the exact time behind each short age in a task's record, why a card's buttons can't be pressed while the Mac you control is out of reach, why a custom API connection can't resume or run your first mate yet, who is driving when a task's browser keeps Back, Forward and Reload from you, why a small picture has no Actual size, what a model's new mark means and that its × removes it from one level only, and a panel's busy dot. Each shows the same label the pointer does, Esc puts it away, and screen readers read the same words.

picture.alt: A task's record: the keyboard on an Activity line's age, 2h, ringed, with its exact time in the label under it
